verdict.rationale: Jitsu's Live Events view shows function logs, warehouse batch statuses, streaming delivery results and dead-lettered events, and all of it can be exported as OTLP logs to Datadog, Grafana and similar tools. Email/Slack alerts fire when warehouse batch jobs or connector syncs fail or recover, and failed events go to a dead-letter queue for replay. Missing for 10: documented per-destination delivery metrics or dashboards (counts, latency, error rates), alerting for streaming (non-batch) destination failures, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the observability features.
